title: StockSmart Logistics Table — Route Delivery Lead Days on a Converted Bin's Reorder Point
content:
StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program: a bin converted from consignment at a par review waits on Corbett's trucks for its customer-owned replenishment.

**Rule.** The route truck deliveries the service level of the program's ship-to schedules each week add further lead days to the conversion reorder point: no route deliveries add 2 days, 1 or 2 a week add 1 day, and 3 or more add none; a ship-to whose service level is not on record adds none.

| Service level of the program's Ship-To Fulfillment Account schedules | Further lead days |
|---|---|
| no route deliveries (0 a week) | 2 days |
| 1 route delivery a week | 1 day |
| 2 route deliveries a week | 1 day |
| 3 or more route deliveries a week | none |
| service level not on record | none, read as 7 a week |
